newsitem.title: USA: Crown Cork buys ACX Tech unit.
newsitem.headline: Crown Cork buys ACX Tech unit.

text.p: Crown Cork & Seal Co Inc said Wednesday it bought Golden Aluminum Co from ACX Technologies Inc for $70 million.
It said the pruchase price includes an immediate cash payment of $10 million and a deferred payment of $60 million, due within two years.
Under the purchase terms, Crown Cork holds a put option that allows it to return Gold Aluminum to ACX if it chooses to exercise the option during the next two years, it said.
ACX can retain a minority stake in Golden Aluminum ranging from 3.6 to 7.3 percent and ACX retains Goldmen Aluminum's capital as of the deal's closing date, it said.
Golden Aluminum uses the so-called continuous block casting or mini-mill technology to produce aluminum for use in making cans and other products.
Crown Cork suplies packaging products to consumer marketing companies around the world.
